title: Centered along both axes in portrait panel
goal: Centers the check-in results and record links as a group up and down, and each item is centered left and right at the same time.
summary: flex-direction determines the spindle. The main axis of column is up and down. justify-content arranges the entire set of content along the main axis, align-items aligns each item along the cross axis.
tasks: retains the vertical arrangement of .arrival-panel and places the two items in the panel as a whole in the middle of the up and down direction.
Center the status prompts and record links on the left and right, and retain the original spacing.
hint: spindle is determined by flex-direction. The panel uses columns. When centered along the main axis, white space will appear above and below the content.

example.note: file upload page can place the progress prompt and cancel button in the center of the panel, and keep the two controls arranged up and down.
